key.name: workspace-count
key.description: The number of active workspaces currently detected by the extension.

key.name: wallpapers-map
key.description: A JSON string storing the wallpaper URI assigned to each workspace index.

key.name: default-wallpaper
key.description: Fallback wallpaper URI to use if no custom wallpaper is set for a workspace.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the quick settings indicator in the top panel.

key.name: switch-delay
key.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before switching the wallpaper, to prevent flickering during rapid workspace switching.
